title: Stop Sign Octagon kyun hota hai? 🛑

shots.vo: अमेरिका के हर स्टॉप साइन के आठ कोने होते हैं। सर्कल क्यों नहीं? या स्क्वायर क्यों नहीं?
shots.prompt: a red octagonal stop sign at a quiet suburban intersection at dusk, low angle, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: America ke har stop sign ke aath kone hote hain. Circle kyun nahi? Ya square kyun nahi?

shots.vo: उन्नीस सौ तेईस। गाड़ियाँ नई थीं, सड़कों पर अफरा-तफरी थी, और हर शहर अपने साइन खुद बनाता था।
shots.prompt: a chaotic 1920s American street with early cars, horses and pedestrians, sepia photo style, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Unnees sau teis. Gaadiyan nayi thin, sadkon par afra-tafri thi, aur har sheher apne sign khud banata tha.

shots.vo: स्टेट हाइवे इंजीनियर शिकागो में मिले, इसे ठीक करने के लिए।
shots.prompt: 1920s engineers in suits around a table covered in road maps and sign drawings, smoky room, oil painting style, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: State highway engineer Chicago mein mile, ise theek karne ke liye.

shots.vo: उनका आइडिया: साइन के जितने ज़्यादा कोने, जगह उतनी ही खतरनाक।
shots.prompt: a row of plain unpainted road sign shapes on a workshop wall: circle, octagon, diamond, square, warm light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: Unka idea: sign ke jitne zyada kone, jagah utni hi khatarnak.

shots.vo: रेलरोड क्रॉसिंग सबसे खतरनाक, उसके लिए सर्कल। और चौराहे पर रुकने के लिए आठ कोने।
shots.prompt: a vintage round railroad crossing sign beside train tracks at sunset, steam train in the distance, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: Railroad crossing sabse khatarnak, uske liye circle. Aur chauraahe par rukne ke liye aath kone.

shots.vo: ऐसा आकार जिसे आप पढ़ने से पहले ही पहचान लें।
shots.prompt: a dirty, partly snow-covered octagonal stop sign on a winter road, shape still unmistakable, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: Aisa aakar jise aap padhne se pehle hi pehchaan lein.

shots.vo: और यहाँ है twist। पहले octagon स्टॉप साइन लाल नहीं थे। वो पीले थे।
shots.prompt: a vintage yellow octagonal stop sign on a 1930s country road, faded paint, sepia tones, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: Aur yahan hai twist. Pehle octagon stop sign laal nahi the. Woh peele the.

shots.vo: लाल पेंट धूप में बहुत जल्दी फीका पड़ जाता था। उन्नीस सौ पचास के दशक में जाकर स्टॉप साइन लाल हुए।
shots.prompt: a bright red octagonal stop sign gleaming under a streetlight at night, rain reflections, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.caption: Laal paint dhoop mein bahut jaldi feeka pad jaata tha. Unnees sau pachaas ke dashak mein jaakar stop sign laal hue.

voice.description: Divya speaks in a calm, expressive storytelling voice at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-sounding, with no background noise.
